selection.exclude: all hashes in v15_seen_hashes.txt plus the first 150 hashes in the deterministic SHA256('SAT-RAG-V15|' + hash) ranking after those exclusions
selection.evaluation_set: all remaining selected hashes; download/size failures are recorded and never replaced

candidate_schedule.fallback: stock Kissat for all remaining wall-clock budget

baselines.primary: stock Kissat 4.0.4 for 5 seconds on same runner
baselines.candidate_control: tuned CryptoMiniSat 5.14.7 for 5 seconds on structurally routed candidates

correctness: verify every SAT model against original CNF
compare completed SAT/UNSAT result to benchmark label when known
proof_caveat: Xorricane UNSAT results are experimental until an independent accepted proof path is added; they must be reported separately from submission-ready certified solves.
